Commit 38ec4944b593 (""gro: ensure frag0 meets IP header alignment"")
did the right thing
column2: but missed the fact that napi_gro_frags() logics

column1: calls for skb_gro_reset_offset() *before* pulling Ethernet header
to the skb linear space.
That said
column2: the introduced check for frag0 address being aligned to 4

column1: always fails for it as Ethernet header is obviously 14 bytes long
and in case with NET_IP_ALIGN its start is not aligned to 4.
Fix this by adding @nhoff argument to skb_gro_reset_offset() which
tells if an IP header is placed right at the start of frag0 or not.
This restores Fast GRO for napi_gro_frags() that became very slow
after the mentioned commit
column2: and preserves the introduced check to

column1: avoid silent unaligned accesses.
